bear_assumptions: Regulation, driver classification, insurance severity and incentives compress marketplace cash flow while autonomous fleets bypass the platform.
base_assumptions: Bookings and trips grow at healthy rates, delivery and advertising improve mix, free cash flow compounds and autonomy partners use Uber distribution without destroying take rates.
bull_assumptions: Mobility, delivery, advertising and membership scale efficiently, insurance improves and Uber becomes a preferred demand layer for multiple autonomous fleets.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after autonomy economics and an accepted relationship clear downside and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade if regulation, insurance, incentives, disintermediation or dilution prevent trip growth from reaching per-share cash flow.
